name: Healing Parables
overview: The Healing Parables reveal God's promise of restoration and peace through obedience and faith in Him. Scripture affirms that God is the ultimate healer who protects His people from affliction when they faithfully follow His commandments (Exodus 15:26). Christ's suffering provides the foundation for our healing, as His wounds bring spiritual and physical restoration (Isaiah 53:5). The Lord invites us to seek His healing and salvation with confidence, assuring that His presence brings abundant health, peace, and truth (Jeremiah 17:14; Jeremiah 33:6). Ultimately, the Sun of righteousness rises with healing in His wings for those who fear God, enabling growth and renewal (Malachi 4:2).
